items.item:
6. No module other than the store module opens the database or opens, names or
   passes a transaction.
   [witness: verification:kernel_a18_store_module_sole_transaction_owner]
statements:
```text
processes_on(data_directory) <= 1
store_change -> one_call AND one_transaction IN store_module
file_published -> complete AND digest_verified AND never_overwritten
symlink_inside(data_directory) -> refused
```

quotes: assert store_modules, "the kernel has a store module"
verdicts.why: The check detects database or transaction-related uses outside the store module, but it does not prove exactly one store call and one transaction per store change. It also does not assert the single-process, complete/digest-verified/never-overwritten publication, or symlink-refusal invariants.
